name: Open Ticket Aging

filters.label: Status
filters.options:
All
Open
Working in Progress
Pending
Waiting for Reply
Reopened

query:
SELECT
    name AS "Ticket:Link/Support Ticket:140",
    subject AS "Subject:Data:230",
    category AS "Category:Data:170",
    priority AS "Priority:Data:90",
    status AS "Status:Data:150",
    opened_at AS "Opened At:Datetime:150",
    TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, opened_at, NOW()) AS "Age Hours:Int:90",
    CASE
        WHEN response_due_at IS NULL THEN 'Not Tracked'
        WHEN first_response_at IS NOT NULL AND first_response_at <= response_due_at THEN 'Met'
        WHEN first_response_at IS NOT NULL OR response_due_at < NOW() THEN 'Missed'
        ELSE 'On Track'
    END AS "First Response SLA:Data:140",
    response_due_at AS "Response Due At:Datetime:150",
    resolution_due_at AS "Resolution Due At:Datetime:150"
FROM `tabSupport Ticket`
WHERE
    status IN ('Open', 'Working in Progress', 'Pending', 'Waiting for Reply', 'Reopened')
    AND (%(status)s = 'All' OR status = %(status)s)
    AND (%(priority)s = 'All' OR priority = %(priority)s)
    AND opened_at >= %(from_date)s
    AND opened_at < DATE_ADD(%(to_date)s, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
ORDER BY opened_at ASC
